The problem & solution

The Problem

  • Two separate HR systems required parallel manual entry every day
  • 5–10 min/day just opening apps, logging in, entering start and end times
  • Monthly reconciliation: 3–4 h fixing daily gaps + 1–2 h end-of-month audit
  • High error risk — missing days and overtime only discovered too late
  • No real-time visibility into hours balance across day, month, quarter

The Solution

  • Garmin Monkey C watch app — one physical button tap to clock in or out
  • Mobile-first web app with live KPIs, manual entry, and sync controls
  • Dual-API sync engine: Push & Pull to both HR systems simultaneously
  • 6-rule validation engine catches overlaps, duplicates, and gaps automatically
  • Google Sheets as live data hub with full audit trail and comparison view
How it works — three layers
1

Google Sheets

Data foundation & sync hub

How it works

Main Hours Table — the live sync target for all entries
Automatic daily / monthly / quarterly hour totals
Custom sync menu: Push, Pull, or Push & Pull both systems
Raw API data tabs, sync log, and comparison view
Native Google Apps Script editor used for development and debugging throughout the build.
2

Mobile Web App

Intelligence & control layer

How it works

Clock In tab: KPI speedometer gauges — today, month, quarter
Manual entry form with project selection, date, and time
Sync tab: configure action, period, and source — then Go
Audit section: missing days detected and fixable in one tap
Mobile-first Google Apps Script web app. No install required — runs in any browser. Built with HTML, CSS, JS inside GAS.
💡
Why not fully automatic?
GPS and Wi-Fi triggers were tested as automatic clock-in/out on both Android and Garmin — both proved unreliable in practice. The pragmatic fix: a native phone Routine fires a tap reminder at work arrival and departure using combined GPS + Wi-Fi conditions. The trigger timestamp also serves as a backup record — if the tap is still missed, Routine history shows the exact moment the reminder fired.
3

Garmin Watch

Hardware endpoint — the 1-tap UX

How it works

Open A-Clock from the Garmin app list on the watch
Tap START on screen or press physical top-right button
End of day: tap END or press bottom-left button
Entry logged instantly to Google Sheets via REST API call
Written in Garmin Monkey C (Connect IQ SDK). Zero prior experience — fully self-taught with AI assistance.
